description: This file is an HTML webpage that demonstrates drag-and-drop widget behavior using the Isomorphic SmartClient framework. It includes scripts to initialize draggable widgets with various appearances and configurations, as well as form controls to manipulate drag options dynamically.

methods.name: setIntersectStyles
methods.description: Dynamically updates the drag intersect style for various draggable widgets, toggling between rectangle and mouse-based interaction.

methods.name: initializeForm
methods.description: Initializes the state of the checkbox controls in the form on page load.
